title: IVG Smart Max Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry delivers a rich and layered berry blend, combining sweet Strawberry, sharp Raspberry and dark Cherry notes. Each puff brings a mix of fruity contrasts that work in harmony for a rounded and satisfying vape. This refill pack includes a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the reservoir supplies e-liquid automatically to the pod, supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. No need to refill or replace coils. The pod uses mesh coil technology to ensure consistent flavour delivery and smooth vapour. Designed exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
